title: Sortilege x Archon Bridge
description: A seamless bridge between Sortilege and Archon. Use Archon spells with Sortilege staves, featuring custom unlearning mechanics and mana integration.
body:
**Overview**

Sortilege x Archon Bridge brings two powerful magic systems together. No longer do you have to choose between the stylish staves of Sortilege and the vast arcane knowledge of Archon. This mod allows your Sortilege staves to act as the ultimate catalyst for all your Archon spells.

**Key Features**

    Spell Learning: Use Archon Spell-Tomes and Soul-Tomes directly with your Sortilege staves.

    Dynamic Fallback: Out of mana? No problem. Your staff will automatically fire the default Sortilege beam if your Archon mana pool is depleted.

    Mana Integration: XP costs for Sortilege shots are removed. The mod fully adopts the Archon Mana system for a unified magical experience.

**The Unlearning System**

Tired of a spell or want to reorganize your arsenal? We’ve added intuitive ways to extract spells back into items:

    Normal Spells: Select the spell on your staff (Sneak + Right-Click), hold an Empty Book in your off-hand, and perform the action again. The spell will be permanently bound to the book, and your staff is cleared.

    Soul-Tomes: Place your staff and a Water Bucket in a crafting table. This "washes away" the most recently learned Soul-Tome, returning the tome to your inventory.
